pages.text: What I drain does not come back. That is why I breed calves only to empty them. The Chronocortex knows a kinder cruelty.$(br2)A $(l)Temporal Field$() grafted onto a $(l)Time$() organism gently rewinds the creatures within six blocks. Every five seconds one of them gets back a dram of whatever it has lost the most of.

pages.title: Its Price
pages.text: Each dram given back costs a dram of the organism's Time, and leaves a little Temporal Stress behind. A Field next to a Leech Tendril makes a farm that never runs dry, if I keep the Time flowing.$(br2)Like the Locket, it is grown by the Chronocortex, and it will grow another.
